item.title: microgpt-c
item.description:
Following Andrej Karpathy’s 200 line python implementation of GPT-2, I wanted to try porting it to C as an exercise in learning the language. This post will lay out my approach in re-implementing microgpt with nothing but the C standard library.

The full code for this project can be found on Github
